method: Resolve the active include graph through cameo_model.
Select only buildable actors with one explicit promotion-token prerequisite.
Classify GrantConditionOnPrerequisite prerequisites as current-faction promotion, current-faction upgrade/doctrine, other-faction upgrade/doctrine, or other.
Attach conditional stat traits to the source condition when the condition name is resolvable; leave unknown condition sources unresolved.

policy.meaning: This receipt inventories condition wiring and stat hooks. It does not remove PromotionUnitBuff, price upgrades, or decide whether any multiplier is fair.
policy.promotion_test_scope: The Sunday no-upgrade comparison can use the fresh actor state; upgrade-conditioned traits are listed separately and are not folded into promotion superiority.

scope: Current RA1 Allies, RA1 Soviets, TD GDI and TD Nod buildable actors with exactly one explicit promotion prerequisite; no YAML or runtime writeback.
